Duplicating a Key from a Photo

This isn't new, I pick locks for fun (my own), the tolerance's (the "play" or "give") on most locks aren't great (tight). So if you can identify the keyway you then know which key blank to buy (unless its a restricted type) Then you need a picture of the key and by counting the pixels of the picture you can gauge the depth of the cuts.The info on the depths and spacing of the cuts are usually easy to find online. from this you can either do some math matching depths to pixels write down the depths eg. from bow to tip y1 654321 (1 at the tip would be the lowest cut) and just ask Mr locksmith to make the key for you, or if your more hands type on buy a blank yourself (as long as its not a restricted keyway or a key under patent) enlarge the photo to the size of the blank on use a vice a file to create your own key.
